# Ads n' Codes

> Marketing and technology agency founded in 2024 by Razal Mohammed, based at B Hive, Level 3, BurJuman Business Tower, Dubai, serving businesses across all seven emirates of the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain).

Contact: bd@adsncodes.com (projects), hello@adsncodes.com (general), +971 56 544 0310 (call and WhatsApp).
